name: get_frame_forces
author: hprebar
title: Get frame member forces
description: Returns internal forces along frame objects for a load case or combination: axial P, shears V2/V3 in kN, torsion T, bending moments M2/M3 in kN·m, at output stations in m. Filter by frame names. Read-only.
notes: OAPI: cAnalysisResultsSetup.DeselectAllCasesAndCombosForOutput/SetCaseSelectedForOutput/SetComboSelectedForOutput, cAnalysisResults.FrameForce. Units: kN, kN·m, m.

frameNames.description: Specific frame names (empty returns all frames)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–500)
